Definition: from G1722 and G5548; to rub in (oil), i.e. besmear:--anoint.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus counsels the Laodiceans to anoint their eyes with eyesalve that they may see in Revelation 3:18 — the church that thought it was rich and needed nothing could not even see itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe I need Christ's eyesalve as much as Laodicea did, because self-deception is the blindness that never feels blind.
RelatedEvents: The Letter to the Church in Laodicea
